title: Add handoff validation to alpha readiness
summary: Alpha readiness now depends on commit-blocked sessions being able to export and verify complete handoff bundles, but the release readiness report does not yet check that handoff toolchain. Add the handoff validator as a read-only readiness signal and document the blocker semantics.
expectedFailureModes: Alpha readiness omits a broken handoff pipeline even though autonomous release preparation depends on dirty work being recoverable.
The readiness check accidentally writes Git metadata, stages files, commits, or pushes while exercising handoff validation.
Release docs list handoff validation as required but the machine-readable readiness report cannot expose that blocker.
nextAction: Wire validate-autonomy-handoff into alpha-release-readiness, document the readiness check in release docs, and validate the JSON/text paths without writing Git metadata.
